message.windcraft.glider.airborne: Use outside water, mounts and creative flight to ready the glider.
tooltip.windcraft.glider.controls: Use: ready/close. Mouse: look; W/S: pitch; A/D: bank and turn; Space: flare; Sneak: close.
tooltip.windcraft.glider.safety: Ready on the ground or deploy immediately in midair. Lift depends on airspeed and wind.
